title: CE60131: Environmental Chemistry And Microbiology
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Introduction, Review of basic concepts in chemistry, chemical thermodynamics,
concept of chemical equilibrium, Equilibrium constants and activity, reaction
kinetics, acid and basis, polyprotic acids and bases, acidity, alkalinity,
carbonate system, pH-CT, buffers, solubility reactions, electrochemistry and
electrochemical cells, nuclear chemistry, nitrogen chemistry and chlorination.
Introduction, the bacteria, the fungi, the algae, protozoa and other higher
forms, viruses, pathogens and disease, microbial growth and enumeration,
environmental influences, control of microorganisms.
